def tower_town(floors=9, lit=0):
    W.sky(1.0)
    W.sun(4.0, rot=(52, 0, 30))
    plane('tt_ground', 400, 400, (0, 0, 0), mat('tt_street', hexc('#6a6a70'), 0.8))
    gray = mat('tt_gray', hexc('#8a8d94'), 0.7)
    for i in range(floors):
        z = 0.0 + i * 6.0
        top = i >= 4
        m = mat('tt_gold', hexc('#e8b830'), 0.3, metal=0.5) if top else gray
        for j, x in enumerate((-16, 16)):
            box('tt_blk%d_%d' % (i, j), (14, 9, 5.8), (x, 22, z + 3.0), m, 0.2)
            wm = mat('tt_gwin', hexc('#fff0a0'), 0.3, emit=hexc('#ffe070'), estr=5.0) if top else mat('tt_gw', hexc('#555b66'), 0.4)
            for k in (-4, 0, 4):
                card('tt_w%d_%d_%d' % (i, j, k), 1.8, 2.4, (x + k, 17.4, z + 3.2), wm, '-Y')
    cyl('tt_post', 0.9, 60, (POST[0], POST[1], 30), mat('tt_postm', hexc('#b8b0a0'), 0.5), 16)
    cyl('tt_redline', 0.95, 0.3, (POST[0], POST[1], RED_Z), mat('tt_red', hexc('#e02020'), 0.4, emit=hexc('#e02020'), estr=0.6), 16)
    cloud_ring((0, 20, 80), 30, 160, 14, seed=3, dz=(-10, 10))
    return True
